integrity: All examples, automorphism calculations, basis formulas and dimension lower bounds are self-contained. Computational checking provides corroboration, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The field must be infinite. The group is the ordinary K-rational automorphism group; no group-scheme or classification of all such algebras is asserted. Novelty comparisons are bounded by accessible sources and historical priorities remain uncertain.
title: Sharp characteristic-dependent dimension for an evolution algebra with infinitely many natural bases and no nontrivial automorphisms
